build_benchmarks: build opt and counters microbenchmarks with a unique name using make and git submodule update
run_bm_build_cli: run the bm_build script with -n flag to specify a unique build name for benchmarking
build_benchmarks_no_counters: build only opt benchmarks by passing --no-counters flag to skip counters benchmark compilation
build_specific_benchmarks: build specific benchmark tests by passing -b flags with benchmark names from available choices
build_with_custom_jobs: build benchmarks using a custom number of parallel jobs with the -j flag
